summary: Testing completed for 48-hour free trial feature implementation. All requested features verified: landing page and pricing page show 48-hour trial badges, FAQs have detailed fee explanations with bullet points, Start Free Trial button works, registration API creates trial accounts with 50 AI credits and sample data, trial-status API returns correct trial info with ~48 hours.

integration_issues.issue: Login page shows login form first despite ?register=true URL parameter. Users need to click 'Create one' link to switch to registration. This is a pre-existing issue from previous iteration.

landing_page_faq_trial.description: FAQ has 'How does the 48-hour free trial work?' with details about 50 AI credits and sample data

pricing_page_trial_badge.description: 48-Hour Free Trial badge shows at top of pricing page

trial_status_api.description: GET /api/billing/trial-status returns correct trial info with hours_remaining, is_trial, is_locked, can_upgrade fields

sample_data_creation.description: Sample customers and jobs are created for new trial accounts

ai_credits_granted.description: 50 AI credits granted on trial account creation
